description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/cartesian_nonuniform_1d/rules/central_D1_nonuniform_dirichlet_bc. Every binding loads fixture.esm (N bound to 8 at the import edge), runs the section-9.6.3 rewrite fixpoint, and must emit a byte-identical expanded AST: the plain D(u,x) replaced by the rule's makearray (interior centered nonuniform first-derivative stencil aggregate over [2,7]; second-order fixed-value Dirichlet wall closures at i=1 and i=8 carrying the free names gL, gR), zero apply_expression_template nodes (the two grid geometry templates the observeds xc and dxw apply to the 9-node edge array xe are fully inlined), zero unlowered rewrite-target ops, zero surviving metaparameter names, with the free-name geometry arrays xc and dxw surviving as index references, the free-name wall values gL and gR surviving as bare name references, and the x_nodes axis folded to size 9. Unlike the zero-gradient first-derivative sibling, the Dirichlet closure reads the control-width observed dxw (halved, as the center-to-wall distance), so dxw is materialized here. This exercises the grid's edge-array contract: a metaparameter-expression index-set size (N+1) and apply_expression_template inside observeds. The golden is generated by the Julia reference runner only (scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh) and compared bytewise by the other bindings.
